channel.title: Global Africa Network Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Global Africa Network Media (globalafricanetwork.com)

item.title: How online trading is reshaping investment across Africa
item.description: Mobile-first trading platforms have opened doors for younger investors and first-time participants. They have also raised the bar for discipline, platform selection, and risk control.

item.title: Investment opportunities in the West Coast District Municipality
item.description: The West Coast District is strategically positioned on South Africa’s western coastline, offering direct access to the Atlantic Ocean and proximity to major markets.

item.title: Africa Border Security Week
item.description: The event will address all three border environments—air, land, and maritime—by convening agencies and stakeholders from these sectors. Taking place 2 – 3 June 2026 | Marriott Hotel Crystal Towers | Cape Town, South Africa

item.title: Africa Energy Indaba 2026 to convene continental leaders for practical energy solutions
item.description: The 18th edition of the Africa Energy Indaba will take place from 3–5 March 2026 at the Cape Town International Convention Centre (CTICC)

item.title: Investment opportunities in the City of Ekurhuleni
item.description: Ekurhuleni is one of the five districts of Gauteng and one of the eight metropolitan municipalities of South Africa.

item.title: Moving giants
item.description: The complex business of getting wind turbines to site requires intricate planning, says Richard Reid, Regional Director of Concord Cranes. From offloading at ports, route choices, assembly and maintenance, precise logistics management is a must.

item.title: Wheeling is working
item.description: In 2025, the 89MW Castle Wind Farm in the Northern Cape Province became the largest private-offtake wind farm to achieve commercial operation in South Africa.

item.title: The private sector is investing in the grid
item.description: Where before the problem was a lack of power to feed the distribution grid, today South Africa must find a way to build a bigger grid.

item.title: Where government goes, cities thrive
item.description: When government locates itself within an already active centre, it reinforces permanence, stability, and confidence. It deepens footfall, supports safety, and gives long-term purpose to existing investment.

item.title: Regional learning exchange highlights industry water stewardship, alternative water sourcing and climate resilience
item.description: The event was hosted from 24–26 February 2026 by the ELIDZ in partnership with the GIZ Natural Resources Stewardship Programme II (NatuReS II).
